The issue is caused by R8 / ProGuard stripping generic signatures (`Signature` attribute) and shrinking anonymous subclasses extending `com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` in release builds (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), preventing Gson from determining the generic type argument at runtime.

### Changes Made

Updated [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r4/work/app/proguard-rules.pro#L3-L18) with the required R8 rules:

- **Preserve generic type metadata and annotations**:
  - `-keepattributes Signature`
  - `-keepattributes *Annotation*`
  - `-keepattributes EnclosingMethod`
  - `-keepattributes InnerClasses`
- **Preserve Gson `TypeToken` and anonymous subclasses**:
  - `-keep class com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }`
  - `-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken`
  - `-keepclassmembers class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { void <init>(); }`
- **Preserve model classes and fields from obfuscation/removal**:
  - `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }`
  - `-keepclassmembers class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }`
